$description: VoteTally (platform/components/VoteTally; owner, vote-live-36, vote-screen-36/37): a live vote as a list of members, each with three icon-only choices, and the totals under it. Its colors come from Button's tone and Badge; these tokens are its frame and spacing.

vote-tally-background.$description: The list's and the totals' surface.

vote-tally-border-color.$description: The frame around the list and the totals.

vote-tally-border-width.$description: The frame around the list and the totals.

vote-tally-gap.$description: The space between the list and the totals.

vote-tally-row-padding-block.$description: A member row's space above and below.

vote-tally-row-padding-inline.$description: A member row's space at its sides.

vote-tally-row-gap.$description: The space between the avatar, the name and the choices.

vote-tally-choices-gap.$description: The space between the three choices.

vote-tally-totals-gap.$description: The space between the totals' badges.
